text: Trim SNDK1 — you're down 14% on a position with no recognizable market data, which means you can't manage risk, set stops, or assess value, so reduce exposure immediately.

Add to ADBE — at just 7.9x earnings with 11.4% free cash flow yield (meaning the company generates a lot of cash relative to its price) and 10.5% revenue growth, this is one of your most attractively valued holdings on a pullback.
Add to META — trading at just 16x earnings while 24% off its highs gives you a rare chance to buy a dominant cash-generating business at a discounted price.
Add to GOOGL — insiders are buying alongside 15% revenue growth and a reasonable 25x valuation, which is a strong confidence signal from people who know the business best.
